0022600221.text: The Grizzlies (6-3, 7th in the West) have lost their last three games and are 2-3 at home, while the Nuggets (5-3, 9th in the West) have won two straight and are 3-1 on the road. Memphis is without Isaiah Stewart (knee bruise), Richie Saunders (knee surgery), and Scotty Pippen Jr. (back soreness), and Denver is missing Julian Strawther (knee sprain). The teams have not met yet this season, and in 2025-26 the Grizzlies lost the series 1-3, including a 136-119 loss in Denver on April 8, 2026.
